metadata.description: Extreme Programming disciplines for Claude Code — TDD, pairing, simple design, planning, and continuous integration, written to hold the line against an LLM's specific failure modes.

plugins.name: xp-tdd
plugins.description: Red-green-refactor as an enforced loop: one failing test at a time, minimum code to pass, run-don't-predict.

plugins.name: xp-pairing
plugins.description: The pairing stance — intellectual honesty and ping-pong handoff. Foundational; pairs well with every other XP plugin.

plugins.name: xp-planning
plugins.description: Thin vertical story slicing and time-boxed spikes — well-shaped work before the TDD loop.

plugins.name: xp-integration
plugins.description: Continuous-integration hygiene: small commits, full suite before every commit, never commit red.
